audience: developers who run models, batch jobs and agents on the Mistral platform

useCases.title: See which models you can use
useCases.text: The AI lists the base models and your fine-tuned models, and opens one for its details.

useCases.title: Track your batch jobs
useCases.text: The AI lists batch inference jobs with optional filters and opens one for its status and details. You see what is running or done.

useCases.title: Cancel a running batch job
useCases.text: The AI checks the job's status and cancels it, so processing and further billing for that job stop.

useCases.title: Find uploaded files or delete one
useCases.text: The AI lists uploaded files (fine-tune data, batch inputs and outputs), reads their metadata or a temporary download URL, and deletes a file you name. Deleting cannot be undone.

useCases.title: Review your agents or create one
useCases.text: The AI lists agents and reads their configuration, or creates a new agent from the settings you give.

useCases.title: Browse your document libraries
useCases.text: The AI lists the RAG document libraries you own or that are shared with you, and the documents uploaded to one library.
